name: Solar radiation
description: How much sunlight the ground receives in a typical year: direct sun past the building shadows, plus the light of the sky it sees.

classify.title: Sunlight per year, kWh/m²
classify.note: PVGIS typical year: direct sun where lit, hourly on a mean day per month (Klein 1977), plus diffuse × sky view factor (Liu & Jordan 1960). Trees left out.
